scientific_integrity: Exact root enumeration from analytic stationary covariance and lobe maxima; finite calculations corroborate rather than replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Stationary isotropic planar chiral active Brownian harmonic model; no finite-sample inference, anisotropic extension, or independent confirmation; zero-count proof exact but not general to other dynamics.
title: Exact zero-count staircase for the stationary heading–position time arrow of a trapped chiral swimmer
